snapshot: SHA256 over complete dense primitive array bytes, with numeric types, array element types and dimensions, tuple/sequence framing, sorted string-keyed metadata, and an explicit native-endian marker. Ordinary Julia hash is not an integrity digest. Retained row matrices are copied into owned read-only storage and fully snapshotted once; subsequent signatures bind their immutable stored digest. Other accessible mutable arrays are completely streamed on validation.
row_ownership: Public writes and writes through views are errors. copy returns an independent mutable matrix. Trusted multiplication delegates read-only use to the retained dense BLAS/generic arithmetic; it does not expose storage. Duplicate queries may share the same owned row object and retain the parent payload accounting.
covered_components: native HOPPET mutable grid, requested scales and auxiliary times
detached point/matching metadata, every block index and row coefficient
polarized initial grids, source bases and cached logarithms
prepared polarized context fixed flavor, CSS, quadrature, provider and provenance arrays
derived observable momentum rules, weights, denominators, angular/source metadata
checks: Compare the stored immutable snapshot with current fixed data before a public numerical application. A mismatch is an explicit error. Fitted initial columns and their derivatives are not snapshot inputs.
preservation: No kernel, solver, sign, mass or z factor, evolution/matching prescription, physical cut, angular definition, data selection or likelihood changes. Existing numerical and derivative tolerances remain unchanged.
limitations: An in-memory mutation guard is not an authenticated serialized production cache
Constructors and program source remain trusted; private getfield/raw-storage access, unsafe memory access and forged internal objects are outside the supported API and are not secured by this guard
Exact byte snapshots can detect changes that leave one tested prediction numerically unchanged
Record complete-check overhead separately; do not infer a production G2PERF pass or relax a failed budget
Historical fit, data covariance/overlap, jet kernels, production admission and interval coverage remain separate requirements
source_bindings: The receipt binds its producer, all numerical source files, all scientific configuration JSON files, the Julia locks and the pinned reference inventory/review, plus verified native and parton builds. Administrative GitHub/task/action metadata is excluded.
type_name_formatting: Store immutable name strings for the 14 Julia built-in primitive numeric types and the internal Tuple{Vector{Int},FixedRowMatrix} block element type at module load. Other element/scalar types retain runtime string(T), including custom displays. Numeric types, framed bytes, full array coverage, dimensions and admission policy are unchanged.
